title: rhus thezera
intro: Rhus thezera, commonly known as the Poisonous Sumac, is a plant species belonging to the Anacardiaceae family. The health benefits of Rhus thezera include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can be utilized to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce pain, inhibit microbial growth, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in Rhus thezera include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
